rationale: Adds .ceil() to get_bound_desired_size()/get_bound_minimum_size() in BoxContainer::_get_minimum_size(p_use_desired_sizes); those symbols and that signature are part of the 4.7 custom_maximum_size feature absent from the fork. Blocker: max-size infra (PR 116640).

Refines Label autowrap warning to also check get_custom_minimum_size, but the condition uses get_combined_maximum_size() which does not exist in the fork (part of the max-size feature). Blocker: PR 116640.

Changes 'it_prev = l.from ? l.from : current' to 'it_prev = l.from' in _shape_line; depends on the it_prev/zero-width-space rework from PR 119987 (70ee45d), and the fork's _shape_line has diverged (no it_prev variable). Port 119987-era RTL shaping first.

Reworks RTL indent/list nesting to use ItemIndent::level/ItemList::level and removes ItemFrame::indent_level, changing push_list/push_indent semantics across append_text. This is a design change to a diverged RTL area, not a self-contained fix.

First hunk edits the 4.7-reworked _find_item_at_pos (parent_allows_drop/current_item_depth/hide_root) which does not exist in the fork's older Tree drag-section code; only the get_drop_section '!drop_mode_flags' guard is cleanly portable. Defer with the Tree drag-section rework.

Introduces it_prev tracking plus a trailing zero-width space after the shaping loop in _shape_line; the fork's _shape_line has diverged (no it_prev, its own 0x200B handling using it->rid). Needs deliberate reconciliation of the RTL last-line-height logic.

Connects SyntaxHighlighter changed signal to a new TextEdit::_syntax_highlighter_changed so highlighting refreshes when regions change; self-contained, fork has the syntax highlighting cache and set_syntax_highlighter. Shader editor call site is not a diverged area.

Core fix is .ceil() on get_combined_minimum_size() before truncating into Size2i, preventing children with non-integer min sizes from being clipped; applies to fork's _resort. Note: the diff's surrounding max-size (propagating_max_size) lines are absent in the fork, so apply just the .ceil().

Reworks BaseButton::gui_input touch/device_id handling introduced by the multitouch feature (PR 110893), which is absent from the fork (no touch_index/device_id in base_button). Blocker: multitouch base feature.
Adjusts separator counting for the PopupMenu search bar; the fork has no PopupMenu search bar (search_bar absent). Blocker: PopupMenu search-bar feature.
Guards RTL list/indent margin math with 'if (tab_size > 0)' to avoid a 1px indent when tab_size is 0; fork's _find_margin lines match the parent exactly. Self-contained.
Draws the SELECT_ROW row rect only once per row via a should_draw_row_rect flag; fork's draw_item still has 'if (i == 0 && select_mode == SELECT_ROW)' matching the parent. Self-contained.

Adds using_native_touch to disable data drag-and-drop only for real touch input (not emulated), replacing the drag_touching check in can_drop_data/get_drag_data; fork has drag_touching and these methods. Self-contained, adds one member.
Uses get_screen_position() instead of get_global_position() when placing the Tree edit popup so it isn't clipped by the window edge; fork has the matching call site (tree.cpp ~5212). One-line fix.

Slider uses _is_focusable() (accounting for accessibility) instead of raw focus-mode check before grab_focus on wheel scroll; moves _is_focusable() to protected. Fork has _is_focusable and get_focus_mode_with_override. Self-contained.

Large filesystem-dock selection rework (320-line dock refactor) that also edits Tree drag-section code and adds a tree.compat.inc shim; touches the diverged Tree drop-section area and introduces a compat shim the clean-break fork avoids. Defer as a dedicated effort.

Reworks _activate_submenu vertical positioning and references submenu_popup->search_bar and theme_cache.search_bar_separation, which are part of the absent PopupMenu search-bar feature. Blocker: search-bar feature + diverged submenu positioning chain.

Moves get_tooltip onto a PopupMenuItems control and scales mouse coordinates by content_scale_factor, relying on the search-bar-era popup structure (PopupMenuItems, search_bar, vbox_container) that the fork lacks. Blocker: diverged/search-era PopupMenu.

Removes the device_id gate in BaseButton::gui_input to allow Alt+Click multi-input; only meaningful on top of the multitouch feature (touch_index/device_id) which is absent from the fork. Blocker: multitouch base feature (PR 110893).

Finalizes deprecation of TabContainer.all_tabs_in_front (getter returns false, property becomes USAGE_NONE) behind DISABLE_DEPRECATED. Depends on the 'tabs always in front' internal change and adds a compat shim; the clean-break fork should decide deliberately. Pairs with PR 118623.
Fixes PopupMenu accessibility around the search bar (_search_bar_focus_entered, _filter_items, vbox_container); all reference the absent search-bar feature. Blocker: PopupMenu search-bar feature.

Changes the meaning of line.from (root line no longer points to main; constructor sets from=nullptr) and updates remove_paragraph accordingly; this is part of the diverged RTL line-from redesign and would interact with the fork's heavy l.from usage. Defer with the RTL shaping rework.
Fixes incorrect PopupMenu tooltips when the search bar is enabled; depends on the absent search-bar feature. Blocker: search-bar feature.
Preserves NAN in Range: _calc_value returns NAN early and set_value skips emitting when both old/new are NAN, so NAN no longer displays as 0. Fork has _calc_value/_snapped_r128. Self-contained.
Splits PopupMenu.search_bar_enabled_on_item_count into two properties; the entire search-bar feature is absent from the fork. Blocker: search-bar feature.

On focus-exit, deselect a non-editing LineEdit when deselect_on_focus_loss_enabled and not a drag attempt, fixing selection lingering on read-only fields; adds one else-if branch. Self-contained (standard LineEdit members present).

Makes TabBar/Label (and many containers) able to shrink under a maximum size; built entirely on the custom_maximum_size/get_combined_maximum_size feature absent from the fork (33 files). Blocker: PR 116640.
Fixes PopupMenu/OptionButton fuzzy search behavior; depends on the absent search-bar/fuzzy-filter feature. Blocker: search-bar feature.
Guards VirtualJoystick action releases behind !is_editor_hint(), but scene/gui/virtual_joystick.* does not exist in the fork. Nothing to port.
Adds perm_hb->set_visible(false) in the ColorPicker constructor so the permission box is hidden on non-macOS; the fork's ColorPicker constructor already has this line. Already present.
Also emits ItemList.item_clicked when CTRL-deselecting a multi-selected item, matching normal click behavior; one added emit_signal in gui_input. Self-contained.
Assigns cached tab metadata as each child is added rather than only on NOTIFICATION_READY; fork has pending_tabs/CachedTab and the NOTIFICATION_READY loop matches the parent. Self-contained.

Sets use_parent_material(true) on internal scrollbars of Tree/ItemList/RichTextLabel/GraphEdit/etc. so a parent material applies to built-in children; trivial one-liners in constructors, all nodes present. Self-contained.
Replaces a single-case switch with an if in TextureButton::has_point; fork's has_point still has the FIXME switch matching the parent. Trivial cleanup.

Reworks _activate_submenu positioning to add scroll_container_offset; the fork's _activate_submenu has diverged variable naming and this is the first of a submenu-positioning chain that culminates in the search-bar-dependent PR 119439. Defer with that chain.
Adds items[i].visible checks to PopupMenu gamepad navigation; item visibility (filtering) is part of the absent search/filter feature. Blocker: item-visibility/filter infra.
Fixes separation for the first *visible* item when items are hidden by filtering; relies on item visibility from the absent search/filter feature. Blocker: filter infra.

Ties the macOS screen-record permission box visibility to sampler_visible so it isn't always shown; fork's ColorPicker matches the parent (has constructor set_visible(false) and the unguarded macOS notification). Self-contained.
Removes RichTextLabel table Column::width_with_padding as unused, but the fork still uses width_with_padding in ~5 table-layout sites. Not applicable.
Adds a separate custom_ci canvas item so custom-drawn content doesn't cover text; custom_ci does not exist in the fork's Tree (4.7 canvas-item rework). Blocker: Tree custom_ci rework.

Defers Tree incremental search so letter/Alt keys can act as shortcuts first (only searches if input wasn't handled); fork has _do_incr_search/incr_search and the matching gui_input path. Self-contained, adds one helper.
Frees a leaked custom_ci RID in the Tree destructor, but the fork's Tree has no custom_ci (nor drop_indicator_ci); its destructor only frees content_ci/header_ci. No leak to fix here.

Deprecates TabContainer.all_tabs_in_front (turns the setter into a warning) behind DISABLE_DEPRECATED, on the premise tabs are 'always in front' due to unrelated internal changes. Adds a compat shim and removes working behavior; the clean-break fork should decide deliberately. Pairs with PR 119420.
Removes the unused TextEdit next_item_id member; fork has it only in the header with no cpp usages. Trivial cleanup.

Adds an is_touch_press_inside branch in BaseButton::on_action_event so multitouch presses inside the button fire; only meaningful with the multitouch feature (screen_touch handling) absent from the fork. Blocker: multitouch base feature.

Adds a per-Control translation_context property plus a Node _get_translation_context_with_override virtual wired into the translation pipeline and scene translation parser; new localization infra not present in the fork. Defer as a feature port.

Despite the title, the diff edits Control::update_maximum_size to sync deferred minimum-size propagation via updating_last_minimum_size; update_maximum_size and the max-size machinery do not exist in the fork. Blocker: PR 116640.

Resets touch_index after a button-press action so later taps aren't dropped, and refines the device_id gate; depends on the multitouch feature (touch_index/device_id) absent from the fork. Blocker: multitouch base feature.
Defers the minimum-size update inside update_maximum_size (call_deferred instead of direct); update_maximum_size does not exist in the fork. Blocker: PR 116640.
Reorders Control inspector Layout-group properties including custom_maximum_size and propagate_maximum_size, which the fork does not bind (max-size feature absent). Blocker: PR 116640.

Improves Tree root and foreign-item drop handling via _determine_hovered_item and the reworked drag-section/_find_item_at_pos code, which the fork's older Tree does not have. Defer with the Tree drag-section rework.
Calls r->_value_changed(val) in Range::Shared::redraw_owners so SpinBox buttons refresh after set_value_no_signal; the fork's redraw_owners already contains this call. Already present.

Gives ItemList custom foreground color priority over selected/hovered theme colors so custom colors (e.g. script list hot color) show; reorders the txt_modulate if-chain. Fork has items[i].custom_fg. Self-contained.
Fixes TabBar minimum-width behavior using combined_max/stop_adding/computed_max_width, which are part of the absent max-size feature. Blocker: PR 116640.
Adds a RichTextLabel option to scale images relative to font size, with a new API, doc changes, and a compat.inc shim. New feature; defer as a dedicated feature port.

Base BaseButton multitouch feature (touch_index/device_id, screen touch/drag handling); absent from the fork and the prerequisite for the multitouch fix chain (PRs 119329/118653/118608/118542). Defer as the feature port that unblocks the rest.
After a full-line paste, updates scrollbars and adjusts the viewport so the caret stays visible; fork's _paste_internal full-line branch matches the parent. Self-contained.
Adds it->subitems.clear() before memdelete in RichTextLabel::remove_paragraph to avoid a crash; the fork's remove_paragraph already has this clear(). Already present.

Overrides the PopupMenu internal ScrollContainer 'panel' style with StyleBoxEmpty so it doesn't inherit a global ScrollContainer theme style; fork has scroll_container. Note: place the override after the fork's scroll_container creation (no vbox_container in the fork).

Restructures RichTextLabel Item RID ownership (Item frees its own rid; drops the owner ObjectID) and raises RID owner capacity in the text servers and accesskit driver. Broad, cross-file, ABI-adjacent; the fork matches the parent Item model but this warrants a deliberate port. Defer.

Adds the Control custom_maximum_size / propagate_maximum_size feature across ~47 files; entirely absent from the fork and the root dependency for the whole max-size fix cluster (118651/118536/118591/118351/118323/120280/120346). Defer as the feature port.
